decision.explanation: The question asks when the Elks organization was founded. Two distinct but related organizations are mentioned in the sources: (1) the Benevolent and Protective Order of Elks (BPOE) in the U.S., which was founded in 1868 (D3S5), and (2) the Elks of Canada, which was founded in 1912 (D1S1). These are separate organizations with shared historical ties, so both founding dates are valid and distinct. Other proposed dates like 1897, 1878, and 1895 refer to other Elks-related groups or local lodges and are not relevant to the general question about the Elks organization.
